name: PartyRole
description: Set follower(s) as the party's tank, healer, or no special role.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers. Can be refused if the NPC does not qualify for the role.

role.description: The role, exactly one of: tank, healer, none.

prompt: If the player asks you to be the party's tank or healer, or to drop that role, begin your response with '{key}:'
